query:
UPDATE jobs
        SET status = 'queued'::job_status,
            attempts = 0,
            scheduled_at = NOW(),
            finished_at = NULL,
            started_at = NULL,
            last_error = NULL,
            owner = NULL
        WHERE status = 'cancelled'::job_status
          AND job_type IN ('ingest_metadata'::job_type, 'ingest_thumbnails'::job_type, 'ingest_analysis'::job_type)
